title: Architecture: Modern Data Stack — CDC-based ELT Pipeline
description: End-to-end CDC-based ELT pipeline capturing PostgreSQL OLTP changes via Debezium, buffering through Kafka to MinIO data lake, loading into Snowflake, and transforming with dbt into analytics-ready Star Schema.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL OLTP
nodes.description: Banking source database with customers, accounts, and transactions tables

nodes.label: Debezium CDC
nodes.description: Captures INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE via PostgreSQL WAL logical replication with pgoutput

nodes.label: Apache Kafka
nodes.description: Transport CDC events across 3 topics: customers, accounts, transactions

nodes.label: Python Micro-batch Consumer
nodes.description: Buffers 50 records or 30s of data, writes Parquet files to MinIO

nodes.label: MinIO Data Lake
nodes.description: S3-compatible object store for Parquet files as persistent, replayable data lake

nodes.label: Snowflake
nodes.description: Cloud data warehouse with COPY INTO for bulk Parquet ingestion

nodes.label: dbt
nodes.description: Staging views, SCD2 snapshots, dimension tables, incremental fact with CDC dedup

nodes.label: Apache Airflow
nodes.description: Main ELT DAG (5min), ingestion DAG, SCD2 snapshots DAG with ShortCircuitOperator

nodes.label: Star Schema Marts
nodes.description: Dimension tables (customers, accounts) and incremental fact (transactions) in ANALYTICS schema
